models.name: ss_track.pt
models.role: Tier-1 prior with the additive SS track — used when the caller supplies an SS profile (peptideSSProfile)
models.arch: modern (ModernPrior: Llama-style decoder RoPE/SwiGLU/RMSNorm + property aux heads + additive ss_track)
models.vocab: 89 tokens (natural 20 + NCAA 18 + <h>/<e>/<l>/<s> SS tokens + length buckets to 120)
models.mechanism: additive_ss_track (left-shifted): per-position SS3 embedding summed onto the residue stream; position i's embedding carries the SS label of residue i+1
models.training_data: SS-annotated corpus + AFDB SS fragments + upsampled PDB binder peptides

models.name: prior.pt
models.role: Base Tier-1 prior (no SS track) — property-tag conditioned generation, FIM editing, GRPO policy anchor
models.training_data: UniRef90 chopped 12M + PDB binders 2257 x6 + PeptideGPT 10.4k; FIM 50%, modality aug, NCAA aug 10%

external_models.name: external/pepmlm650/
external_models.role: PepMLM-650M — the receptor-conditioned prior (ChatterjeeLab, Nat Biotech 2025). Required whenever a target receptor is supplied; there is no fallback.
external_models.protocol: receptor + <mask>*N one-shot parallel top-k=3 decoding; one-mask-at-a-time pseudo-PPL ranking; mask & re-infill elite refinement

external_models.name: external/esm3_sm_open_v1.pth
external_models.role: ESM3-open 1.4B — the trainable policy backbone for the online RL loop (LoRA adapters; proposal policy improves per target via ipSAE+pLDDT rewards)
external_models.arch: ESM3 (masked multimodal LM), d1536/48L, 64-token sequence vocab (canonical L-20 only)
